title.en: Minister says Starmer is ‘listening’ but refuses to say if PM will stay on ahead of critical cabinet meeting – UK politics live
title.zh: 大臣称斯塔默“正在倾听”，但在关键内阁会议前拒绝透露首相是否会留任——英国政治直播

summary.en: Darren Jones, the chief secretary to the prime minister, stated that the PM is "listening to colleagues" but did not rule out the possibility of the prime minister announcing a resignation timetable. This comes as cabinet ministers are reportedly urging the PM to quit ahead of a critical cabinet meeting.
summary.zh: 首相首席秘书达伦·琼斯表示，首相“正在倾听同事的意见”，但并未排除首相宣布辞职时间表的可能性。此前有报道称，内阁部长们在一次关键内阁会议前敦促首相辞职。

body.en: Darren Jones says the prime minister is ‘listening to colleagues’, and does not rule out PM announcing resignation timetable Starmer on the brink as cabinet ministers urge him to quit Here are some pictures from No 10 this morning. Darren Jones , the chief secretary to the PM, is now being interviewed on the Today programme. Nick Robinson , the presenter, is asking him if he knows whether Keir Starmer has decided how to respond to the pressure on him to resign. Jones is avoiding the question, as he did on Sky News earlier. (See 7.43am .) Continue reading...
body.zh: 达伦·琼斯表示，总理正在“倾听同事们的意见”，并且不排除总理宣布辞职时间表。斯塔默正处于内阁部长敦促他辞职的边缘。以下是今天早上 10 号的一些照片。首相首席秘书达伦·琼斯目前正在接受《今日》节目的采访。主持人尼克·罗宾逊问他是否知道凯尔·斯塔默是否已经决定如何应对他辞职的压力。琼斯回避了这个问题，就像他早些时候在天空新闻中所做的那样。 （参见上午 7.43 点。）继续阅读...

reflection.en: The stability of leadership often rests on a foundation of integrity and righteous governance. When a leader faces calls to resign from their own cabinet, it highlights the immense pressure and scrutiny inherent in public office. This situation reminds us that true authority is sustained not merely by power, but by actions that uphold justice and trust.
reflection.zh: 领导层的稳定往往建立在正直和公义治理的基础之上。当一位领导人面临来自其内阁的辞职呼吁时，这突显了公职所固有的巨大压力和审视。这提醒我们，真正的权威不仅仅靠权力维持，更要靠维护公义和信任的行动来维系。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: EU defence ministers meet for talks on Ukraine – Europe live
title.zh: 欧盟国防部长就乌克兰问题举行会谈——欧洲直播

summary.en: EU defense ministers met in Brussels to discuss ongoing conflicts in Ukraine and the Middle East, as well as plans to increase defense manufacturing. These talks followed the breakdown of a three-day ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine, which ended with renewed Russian strikes.
summary.zh: 欧盟国防部长在布鲁塞尔举行会议，讨论乌克兰和中东地区的持续冲突，以及增加国防生产的计划。此次会谈是在俄罗斯和乌克兰之间为期三天的停火协议破裂，并伴随新一轮俄罗斯袭击之后进行的。

body.en: Ministers to also discuss how to ramp up defence manufacturing and the situation in the Middle East Today’s talks in Brussels come as the three-day ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine announced by president Donald Trump last week ended with a fresh wave of Russian strikes. AFP reported that Moscow launched a wave of more than 200 attack drones that damaged energy facilities and apartment buildings, killing at least one person. “Attack drones were shot down in the Dnipro, Zhytomyr, Mykolaiv, Sumy, Kharkiv, and Chernihiv regions, as well as in Kyiv and the region. Energy facilities, apartment buildings, and a kindergarten were damaged, and there was also a strike on an ordinary civilian locomotive on the railway... People have been reported injured as a result of these strikes. And, unfortunately, there are fatalities.” “ Russia must end this war, and it is Russia that must take the step toward a real, lasting ceasefire. Until that happens, sanctions against Moscow are necessary and must remain in place and be strengthened. It is important that there be no easing of pressure and that partners do not stand aside, but continue working together for security, justice, and a reliable peace.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 部长们还将讨论如何加强国防制造业和中东局势 今天在布鲁塞尔举行的会谈正值唐纳德·特朗普总统上周宣布的俄罗斯和乌克兰之间为期三天的停火，以俄罗斯新一波的袭击结束。法新社报道称，莫斯科发射了一波超过 200 架攻击无人机，损坏了能源设施和公寓楼，造成至少一人死亡。 “攻击无人机在第聂伯罗、日托米尔、尼古拉耶夫、苏梅、哈尔科夫和切尔尼戈夫地区以及基辅和该地区被击落。能源设施、公寓楼和幼儿园被损坏，铁路上的普通民用机车也遭到袭击……据报道，有人因这些袭击受伤。不幸的是，有人死亡。” “俄罗斯必须结束这场战争，俄罗斯必须迈出实现真正、持久停火的一步。在此之前，对莫斯科的制裁是必要的，必须继续实施并加强。重要的是，压力不能放松，合作伙伴也不能袖手旁观，而是继续共同努力，以实现安全、正义和可靠的和平。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: As talks focus on increasing defense manufacturing amidst renewed conflict, the prophetic vision of Isaiah offers a profound counterpoint. It reminds us of a future where instruments of war are transformed into tools for peace and productivity. This hope encourages us to seek paths that prioritize lasting reconciliation over the perpetual cycle of armament.
reflection.zh: 当会谈聚焦于在冲突重燃之际增加国防生产时，以赛亚书的预言提供了一个深刻的对照。它提醒我们，未来战争的工具将被转化为和平与生产的工具。这份盼望鼓励我们寻求优先考虑持久和解的道路，而非永无止境的军备循环。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Federal budget 2026 live updates: Australia government budget announcement and speech tonight – latest news
title.zh: 2026年联邦预算实时更新：澳大利亚政府今晚公布预算案并发表讲话——最新消息

summary.en: The Australian Treasurer is expected to announce changes to the capital gains tax discount when he delivers the 2026 federal budget later tonight.
summary.zh: 预计澳大利亚财政部长将在今晚公布的2026年联邦预算中宣布对资本利得税折扣进行调整。

body.en: Treasurer expected to announce changes to the capital gains tax discount when he delivers the 2026 federal budget later tonight. Follow the latest updates Federal budget 2026: what we know so far See all our Australia budget 2026 coverage Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast ‘Let’s build more houses … not start taxing them’, shadow finance minister says Claire Chandler , the shadow minister for finance, spoke a moment ago. You don’t make more of something by increasing taxes on it. Taxes are inherently a disincentive to create more of something. If we need more houses in this country, let’s build more houses. Let’s not start taxing them. It’s all of our housing programs, 5% deposit, the Housing Australia Future Fund, the partnership we’ve had with the states and territories, the announcement made … on the weekend or yet around enabling infrastructure, $2bn to do the kind of the back end of housing development, all the connections and all of that kind of thing that state and territory and local government struggle with. I think there is a lot of understanding across the community about governments needing to respond to try and make housing more affordable. This isn’t about generation versus generation. Continue reading...
body.zh: 财政部长预计将在今晚晚些时候提交 2026 年联邦预算时宣布资本利得税折扣的变化。关注最新动态 2026 年联邦预算：到目前为止我们所知道的 查看我们对 2026 年澳大利亚预算的所有报道 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 影子财政部长克莱尔·钱德勒 (Claire Chandler) 表示，“让我们建造更多房屋……而不是开始对它们征税”。你不会通过增加税收来赚更多的钱。税收本质上是抑制创造更多东西的因素。如果我们国家需要更多的房子，那就建造更多的房子。我们不要开始向他们征税。这是我们所有的住房计划、5%的首付、澳大利亚住房未来基金、我们与各州和领地的合作伙伴关系、周末或尚未发布的公告……围绕基础设施建设、20亿澳元用于住房开发的后端、所有的联系以及所有州、领地和地方政府努力解决的事情。我认为，整个社会对于政府需要做出回应以努力使住房更加负担得起有很多共识。这不是一代人与一代人之间的问题。继续阅读...

reflection.en: A federal budget, including tax policy changes, reflects a nation's priorities and its commitment to justice for all citizens. Jeremiah reminds leaders of their divine mandate to act with righteousness, ensuring policies protect the vulnerable and promote fairness. Such decisions carry significant weight, shaping the well-being of many.
reflection.zh: 联邦预算，包括税收政策的调整，反映了一个国家的优先事项及其对所有公民公正的承诺。耶利米书提醒领导者，他们有神圣的使命以公义行事，确保政策保护弱势群体并促进公平。这些决定意义重大，塑造着许多人的福祉。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Fortescue ordered to pay Yindjibarndi traditional owners $150m in record native title payout
title.zh: Fortescue被勒令向Yindjibarndi原住民支付1.5亿美元，创下原住民土地所有权赔偿金纪录

summary.en: An Australian federal court has ordered mining company Fortescue to pay $150 million to the Yindjibarndi traditional owners. The court found that the company's Solomon Hub iron ore mine caused cultural and social harm, including the destruction of 140 heritage sites.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚联邦法院勒令矿业公司Fortescue向Yindjibarndi原住民支付1.5亿美元。法院裁定，该公司在所罗门枢纽的铁矿开采对原住民造成了文化和社会损害，包括摧毁了140处遗产地。

body.en: Federal court found miner’s Solomon Hub iron ore mine caused cultural and social harm, including the destruction of 140 heritage sites Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Mining company Fortescue has been ordered to pay $150m in compensation to traditional owners over cultural losses caused by the multibillion-dollar Solomon Hub iron ore mine – the largest compensation payout in native title history. The mine, which has extracted millions of tonnes of iron ore and generated an estimated $80bn in revenue for Fortescue since operations began in 2013, was approved by the Western Australian government without the consent of the Yindjibarndi traditional owners. Continue reading...
body.zh: 联邦法院认定矿工的 Solomon Hub 铁矿造成了文化和社会危害，包括对 140 个遗产地的破坏 关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客以获取最新更新 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 矿业公司 Fortescue 已被责令向传统所有者支付 1.5 亿美元的赔偿，以弥补价值数十亿美元的 Solomon Hub 铁矿造成的文化损失——这是土著产权历史上最大的赔偿支出。该矿自 2013 年开始运营以来，已开采了数百万吨铁矿石，并为 Fortescue 创造了约 800 亿澳元的收入，该矿在未经 Yindjibarndi 传统所有者同意的情况下获得了西澳大利亚州政府的批准。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This landmark ruling underscores the importance of speaking up for the rights of those whose heritage and well-being have been harmed. It reminds us that true justice often involves recognizing past wrongs and making restitution to communities that have been marginalized or overlooked.
reflection.zh: 这一里程碑式的裁决强调了为那些文化遗产和福祉受损者发声的重要性。它提醒我们，真正的公义往往涉及承认过去的错误，并向那些被边缘化或忽视的社区作出赔偿。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Middle East crisis live: Iran could enrich uranium to weapons grade if attacked, senior lawmaker warns
title.zh: 中东危机：伊朗高级议员警告称，若受攻击，伊朗可能将铀浓缩至武器级别

summary.en: A senior Iranian lawmaker warned that the country could enrich its uranium to weapons-grade levels if attacked, a move that would be reviewed by parliament. This statement comes amid ongoing tensions and past efforts by former US President Donald Trump to prevent Iran from developing nuclear weapons.
summary.zh: 一位伊朗高级议员警告称，如果该国受到攻击，可能会将铀浓缩至武器级别，议会将审议此举。此番言论是在持续的紧张局势以及美国前总统唐纳德·特朗普过去阻止伊朗发展核武器的努力背景下发表的。

body.en: Ebrahim Rezaei says in social media post that the country could enrich its stocks of uranium to 90% and will review such a move in parliament ​Donald Trump said one of his central objectives in launching ‌a war against Iran was to ensure Tehran does not develop a ​nuclear weapon. ​Iran – which insists its nuclear programme is peaceful – is reportedly yet to hand over more than 400 kg ⁠of uranium enriched up to 60%, a short, technical step from weapons-grade levels of 90%. Continue reading...
body.zh: 易卜拉欣·雷扎伊在社交媒体帖子中表示，该国可以将其铀库存浓缩至 90%，并将在议会审查这一举措。唐纳德·特朗普表示，他对伊朗发动战争的核心目标之一是确保德黑兰不会发展核武器。据报道，坚称其核计划是和平目的的伊朗尚未交出超过 400 公斤浓缩度高达 60% 的铀，这距离武器级 90% 的水平仅是一个简短的技术步骤。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The threat of escalating to weapons-grade uranium highlights the perilous cycle of violence, where one threat begets another. Jesus' words remind us that choosing the path of the "sword" often leads to self-destruction, urging us to seek alternatives to escalating conflict.
reflection.zh: 将铀浓缩至武器级别的威胁凸显了危险的暴力循环，一个威胁往往会引发另一个威胁。耶稣的话语提醒我们，选择“刀剑”之路常常导致自我毁灭，敦促我们寻求升级冲突之外的替代方案。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: Elon Musk and Tim Cook among CEOs expected to accompany Trump on China trip
title.zh: 特朗普访华，埃隆·马斯克和蒂姆·库克等首席执行官预计随行

summary.en: Seventeen US executives, including Elon Musk and Tim Cook, are expected to accompany the president on his trip to China, where he will meet with his Chinese counterpart, Xi Jinping.
summary.zh: 包括埃隆·马斯克和蒂姆·库克在内的17位美国企业高管预计将随同总统访问中国，届时总统将与中国国家主席习近平会晤。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump is expected to bring a host of top business and technology industry executives on his trip to China this week.

Among those set to join the president on his official trip to Beijing are Tim Cook of Apple, Elon Musk of Tesla and SpaceX, Larry Fink of BlackRock, as well as other executives from Meta, Visa, JP Morgan, Boeing, Cargill and more.

In total, 17 US executives will join Trump on the trip, a White House official with knowledge of the plans told the BBC.

The trip is seen as important for the US, as Trump will meet with President Xi Jinping at a time of growing economic and technological animosity between the two countries.

Absent from the list is Nvidia boss Jensen Huang, whose company is central to the rivalry between the US and China over computer chips and artificial intelligence (AI).

The BBC has contacted Nvidia for comment. Last week, Huang told business news channel CNBC that it would be a "privilege" to represent the US in China if he was invited on the trip.

It is also notable that Sanjay Mehrotra, the CEO of Micron Technology, will be part of Trump's delegation.

His presence is interesting as Beijing restricted the use of some Micron chips in critical infrastructure in 2023 on national security grounds - a move the firm has said negatively impacted its business in China.

Semiconductors remain central to the US-China economic relationship, despite ongoing tensions over technology and export controls.

Chuck Robbins, chief executive and chairman of Cisco, had been invited to be a part of the trip "but is unable to due to earnings," according to a company spokeswoman.

Together, the executives represent a swath of US business interests, from social media and consumer hardware, to computer chips and commercial manufacturing.

A spokeswoman for Illumina, a biotechnology company based in Californa, said Thaysen "is honored to be part of the delegation" and that the company hopes the trip will be "an opportunity to strengthen relationships and shape the future of precision medicine."

Representatives of the other companies did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

Trump's visit to China will be the first by a US president in nearly a decade and marks a key test of a fragile trade truce between the two countries, following a tit-for-tat trade war which saw them roll out tariffs which at times topped 100%.

The tariffs were paused in October 2025 after Trump's last meeting with Xi, which took place in South Korea.

Looming large over the upcoming meeting will be the US and Israel's war in Iran , which has already forced a delay to Trump and Xi's meeting.

Trump is expected to push China, which relies on Iran for cheap oil, to help facilitate an agreement between Tehran and Washington to end the...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普本周预计将携带一批商业和科技行业的高级管理人员访问中国。 即将随总统正式访问北京的人士包括苹果公司的蒂姆·库克、特斯拉和 SpaceX 的埃隆·马斯克、贝莱德的拉里·芬克，以及来自 Meta、Visa、摩根大通、波音、嘉吉等公司的其他高管。 一位了解该计划的白宫官员告诉 BBC，总共有 17 名美国高管将与特朗普一起出访。 这次访问对美国来说非常重要，因为特朗普将在两国经济和技术敌意日益加剧之际会见习近平主席。 值得注意的是，英伟达(Nvidia)老板黄仁勋(Jensen Huang)并未出现在这份名单中，他的公司是中美计算机芯片和人工智能(AI)竞争的核心。 BBC 已联系 Nvidia 请其置评。上周，黄向商业新闻频道 CNBC 表示，如果他受邀访问中国，代表美国访问中国将是一种“荣幸”。 思科公司发言人表示，思科首席执行官兼董事长查克·罗宾斯曾受邀参加此次旅行，“但由于盈利原因未能成行”。 这些高管共同代表了美国的一系列商业利益，从社交媒体和消费硬件到计算机芯片和商业制造。 总部位于加利福尼亚州的生物技术公司 Illumina 的发言人表示，塞森“很荣幸成为代表团的一员”，该公司希望这次旅行将成为“加强关系和塑造精准医疗未来的机会”。 其他公司的代表没有立即回应置评请求。 特朗普对中国的访问标志着两国之间脆弱的贸易休战的一次关键考验，此前两国在针锋相对的贸易战中征收了有时高达100%的关税。 特朗普在韩国与习近平最后一次会面后，关税于 2025 年 10 月暂停。 即将举行的会议的一大焦点将是美国和以色列在伊朗的战争，这已经迫使特朗普和习近平的会面推迟。 预计特朗普将推动依赖伊朗获取廉价石油的中国帮助促成德黑兰和华盛顿之间达成协议以结束战争。 中国也希望结束冲突。它限制了该国的石油供应，打击了进口中国商品的世界其他国家的购买力。 但迄今为止，中国丰富的石油储量和多样化的能源供应帮助其比许多邻国更好地抵御了战争的影响。

reflection.en: High-level diplomatic visits, especially those involving significant economic figures, underscore the complexity of international relations. The proverb reminds us that in the multitude of counselors there is safety, suggesting that important national decisions benefit from diverse perspectives and wise advice. As leaders navigate intricate global...
reflection.zh: 高级别的外交访问，特别是涉及重要经济人物的访问，凸显了国际关系的复杂性。这句箴言提醒我们，谋士众多，人便安居，这表明重要的国家决策受益于多样的视角和明智的建议。当领导人应对错综复杂的全球挑战时，寻求广泛的忠告可以为所有人带来更稳定和有益的成果。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Pakistan struck a rehab centre and killed 269 Afghans. Their families want to know why
title.zh: 巴基斯坦袭击康复中心致269名阿富汗人死亡，家属追问原因

summary.en: An airstrike on March 16 reportedly killed 269 Afghans at a rehab center, prompting calls for an investigation into the incident as a potential war crime. The United Nations suggests the actual death toll may be higher.
summary.zh: 据报道，3月16日的一次空袭造成一家康复中心的269名阿富汗人死亡，引发了将此事件作为战争罪进行调查的呼吁。联合国表示，实际死亡人数可能更高。

body.en:
On a rainy, cold morning Masooda makes her way to a hillside cemetery in north-west Kabul to visit the grave of her younger brother Mirwais.

But she doesn't know exactly where he was buried after he was killed in a Pakistani airstrike two months ago.

Instead, she stands at the edge of a mass grave, neatly covered with tiny white stones and roughly marked with grey granite slabs, which is the final resting place of some of the at least 269 people killed in the attack on a drug rehabilitation centre.

Exactly how many are in the grave is impossible to say: like Mirwais, who was 24, many were barely identifiable – reduced to body parts or burned beyond recognition.

"My brother's body was in pieces. There was barely anything left of him to give us," says Masooda, 27, breaking down as she speaks. "They just found his torso. I identified it through a birthmark he had."

The attack on the Omid Drug Rehabilitation Hospital is the deadliest attack in Afghanistan, possibly ever, but certainly in recent history, including 20 years of war between the Taliban, and Nato and Afghan republic forces.

A report released on Tuesday by the United Nations puts the number they can confirm at 269, but acknowledges the real figure is likely to be significantly higher.

Fighting between Pakistan and Afghanistan has been going on for months, leaving hundreds dead, most of them from Pakistani airstrikes. Islamabad accuses the Taliban government of sheltering militants who attack Pakistan . Kabul denies doing so.

The carnage at the drug rehab centre accounts for most of those killed in the fighting this year. The scale of the death toll is so staggering it has shocked Afghanistan, despite its long familiarity with violent conflict.

The UN, which was given access to the site, as well as the BBC's Afghan service teams who were on the ground in the immediate aftermath, confirm the strike hit civilians undergoing treatment. Human Rights Watch called it "an unlawful attack and a possible war crime".

But Pakistan disputes it hit a civilian target. In a statement to the BBC it said that "no hospital, no drug rehabilitation centre, and no civilian facility was targeted", adding: "The targets were military and terrorist infrastructure."

"Pakistan is lying. I have seen it and it wasn't a military camp. There were men admitted there who had come to get healed and return to their families," says Masooda.

She is not alone. The BBC has spoken to the families of more than 30 victims – including those of recovering addicts, and employees of the centre - who reject Pakistan's claims.

Omid centre may be located in a former military training compound called Camp Phoenix, which used to be used by the US and Nato forces, but it is far from new.

body.zh: 在一个阴雨绵绵、寒冷的早晨，马苏达前往喀布尔西北部的一个山坡公墓，为弟弟米尔韦斯扫墓。 但两个月前他在巴基斯坦空袭中丧生后，她不知道他到底被埋在哪里。 相反，她站在一个集体坟墓的边缘，上面整齐地覆盖着白色的小石头，并用灰色花岗岩板粗略地标记，这是在戒毒中心袭击中至少 269 人丧生的部分人的最后安息之地。 确切地说有多少人在坟墓里是不可能的：就像 24 岁的米尔韦斯一样，许多人几乎无法辨认——只剩下身体部位或被烧得面目全非。 “我哥哥的尸体已经支离破碎。他几乎没有任何东西可以给我们了，”27 岁的马苏达说道，她的情绪崩溃了。 “他们刚刚找到了他的躯干。我通过他身上的胎记认出了它。” 对奥米德戒毒医院的袭击是阿富汗最致命的袭击，可能是历史上最致命的袭击，但肯定是近代史上最严重的袭击，包括塔利班、北约和阿富汗共和国军队之间的 20 年战争。 联合国周二发布的一份报告称，他们可以确认的数​​字为 269，但承认实际数字可能要高得多。 巴基斯坦和阿富汗之间的战斗已经持续数月，造成数百人死亡，其中大部分死于巴基斯坦的空袭。伊斯兰堡指责塔利班政府庇护袭击巴基斯坦的武装分子。喀布尔否认这样做。 今年战斗中丧生的大部分人都是在戒毒所发生的。尽管阿富汗长期经历暴力冲突，但死亡人数之多令人震惊。 获准进入现场的联合国以及事后立即赶到现场的 BBC 阿富汗服务队证实，袭击袭击了正在接受治疗的平民。人权观察称其为“非法袭击，可能构成战争罪”。 但巴基斯坦否认它击中了平民目标。在给英国广播公司的一份声明中，它表示“没有医院、戒毒中心和民用设施成为攻击目标”，并补充说：“目标是军事和恐怖分子基础设施。” 马苏达说：“巴基斯坦在撒谎。我亲眼所见，那不是军营。有些人是来这里接受治疗并返回家人身边的。” 她并不孤单。 BBC 已与 30 多名受害者的家属进行了交谈，其中包括正在康复的吸毒者以及该中心的员工，他们拒绝接受巴基斯坦的说法。 奥米德中心可能位于一个名为“凤凰营”的前军事训练场内，该训练场曾被美国和北约部队使用，但它远非新建的。 2016年开业，继美国人...

title.en: France seeks to move beyond colonial ties by meeting African leaders in Kenya
title.zh: 法国寻求通过在肯尼亚会见非洲领导人来超越殖民关系

summary.en: In a significant shift, France is meeting African leaders in Kenya, marking the first time such a meeting has occurred outside France since these gatherings began in the 1970s. This move signals a change in France's approach to its historical ties with African nations.
summary.zh: 法国在肯尼亚会见非洲领导人，这是自20世纪70年代此类会议开始以来首次在法国境外举行，标志着法国思维的转变，旨在超越殖民关系。

body.en:
Accused of neo-colonial meddling in many African countries where it has traditionally had close ties, France is broadening its horizons by co-hosting a summit of African leaders in English-speaking Kenya for the first time.

Speaking at the Africa Forward Summit in the capital Nairobi on Monday, French President Emmanuel Macron announced investments worth $27bn (£20bn) in Africa in areas such as energy transition, digital and AI, the maritime economy and agriculture.

"Africa is succeeding. It's the youngest continent in the world… and needs investment to become more self-reliant," he said, adding that this would create some 250,000 jobs in Africa, and in France.

"We are not simply here to come and invest on the African continent alongside you - we need the great African business leaders to come and invest in France," he told the audience at Nairobi's convention centre, reports the AFP news agency.

The two-day summit is aimed at broadening Paris's partnerships and making investment deals on the continent against a backdrop of rising anti-French sentiment and diminishing power in its former colonies, especially in West Africa. This reflects a step-change in how Paris thinks of its relationships with Africa.

For many years after independence in the 1960s, France maintained close economic, political and security ties in many of its former colonies, leading to widespread accusations that little had changed.

And French presidents over the years have held regular summits with African leaders - either in France or French-speaking Africa - until now.

Gilles Yabi, a Senegal-based political analyst focusing on relations between France and Africa, told the BBC's Newsday programme: "There's a new generation of Africans who… want to turn the page on colonialism and post-colonial influence."

Kenya's Foreign Minister Musalia Mudavadi called it an "opportunity for Africa to start speaking as one".

"Having this summit being held in a non-French-speaking African country on the continent, to me, is a very, very big message that we should not be looking at engagements on the basis of the official languages that are spoken in those countries," he told the BBC.

He said it was an "opportune moment" for Kenya and France to break away from the "more or less artificial" linguistic barriers stemming from countries being "branded" as Anglophone, Francophone or Lusophone, which "deters proper integration".

"Kenya has been a pivotal country on matters of diplomacy and also conventions," Mudavadi added, explaining that the summit will cover peace and security, and then focus "largely on the economic partnership that can be developed between Africa and the rest of the world, including France".

Last week, Foreign Affairs Principal Secretary Korir Sing'oei similarly spoke...
body.zh: 法国被指控对许多传统上有着密切联系的非洲国家进行新殖民主义干涉，但法国首次在英语国家肯尼亚共同主办非洲领导人峰会，以拓宽视野。 周一，法国总统马克龙在首都内罗毕举行的非洲前进峰会上发表讲话，宣布在非洲能源转型、数字和人工智能、海洋经济和农业等领域投资 270 亿美元（200 亿英镑）。 “非洲正在​​取得成功。它是世界上最年轻的大陆……需要投资来变得更加自力更生，”他说，并补充说这将为非洲和法国创造约 25 万个就业机会。 据法新社报道，他在内罗毕会议中心对观众说：“我们不仅仅是来和你们一起来非洲大陆投资，我们需要伟大的非洲商界领袖来法国投资。” 这次为期两天的峰会旨在扩大巴黎的伙伴关系，并在反法情绪高涨、前殖民地（尤其是西非）权力减弱的背景下，在非洲大陆达成投资协议。这反映出巴黎对于与非洲关系的看法发生了巨大变化。 20 世纪 60 年代独立后的许多年里，法国与其许多前殖民地保持着密切的经济、政治和安全联系，导致人们普遍指责这种联系几乎没有改变。 多年来，法国总统一直与非洲领导人定期举行峰会——无论是在法国还是法语区的非洲——直到现在。 塞内加尔的政治分析师吉尔斯·亚比（Gilles Yabi）专注于法国与非洲之间的关系，他告诉英国广播公司（BBC）的《新闻日》节目：“新一代非洲人……想要翻开殖民主义和后殖民影响的新一页。” 肯尼亚外交部长穆萨利亚·穆达瓦迪称这是“非洲开始作为一个整体发言的机会”。 他告诉英国广播公司：“对我来说，在非洲大陆的一个非法语非洲国家举行这次峰会是一个非常非常重要的信息，即我们不应该根据这些国家使用的官方语言来考虑接触。” 他表示，对于肯尼亚和法国来说，这是摆脱“或多或少人为的”语言障碍的“适当时机”，这些障碍源于被“贴上”英语、法语或葡语国家“标签”的国家，这些障碍“阻碍了适当的融合”。 穆达瓦迪补充说：“肯尼亚一直是外交和公约问题上的关键国家。”他解释说，峰会将涵盖和平与安全，然后重点关注“非洲与包括法国在内的世界其他国家之间可以发展的经济伙伴关系”。 上周，外交部首席秘书科里尔·辛奥伊也发表了类似的讲话……

reflection.en: The effort to move beyond colonial ties reflects a desire to dismantle historical barriers and build relationships rooted in mutual respect. Just as Christ broke down the dividing wall of hostility, nations can strive to overcome past divisions and forge new paths of partnership. This pursuit of reconciliation and equitable engagement offers hope for a more...
reflection.zh: 这种超越殖民关系的努力，反映了拆除历史障碍、建立基于相互尊重的关系的愿望。正如基督拆毁了敌意的隔墙，各国也能努力克服过去的隔阂，开辟新的伙伴关系之路。这种对和解和公平交往的追求为建立一个更公正的全球社会带来了希望。

title.en: Town 'at the end of the world' denies hantavirus origins as travellers warned
title.zh: 旅行者警告称，“世界尽头”的小镇否认汉坦病毒起源

summary.en: Authorities have pointed the finger at an Argentine tourism hotspot, but locals have accused the government of a "smear campaign".
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
As countries around the world work to safely quarantine passengers who were on board the cruise ship at the heart of a deadly hantavirus outbreak, authorities are urgently working to trace the outbreak's origins.

Eight cases have been linked to the outbreak that has killed three people, after the rare, rodent-born virus was detected last week on Dutch cruise ship the MV Hondius.

The last passengers have been evacuated from the ship , prompting the cruise's captain Jan Dobrogowski to thank the crew and guests for their patience and kindness.

Four Australians, one Australian resident and a New Zealand citizen have arrived in the Netherlands and will be flown to Perth for three weeks of quarantine .

The World Health Organization (WHO) has said that while it does not expect the hantavirus cluster to trigger a global outbreak, authorities are still eager to know how the virus made its way onto the ship.

Eyes have fallen on Argentina, where the Dutch couple who first fell ill — and later died — boarded the cruise.

The virus is endemic in parts of the country, with the country's Ministry of Health reporting 101 infections since July last year.

The Australian government has since updated its travel advice for the country, saying the virus "continues to be a risk in Argentina" but advising travellers to exercise normal safety precautions.

Despite being endemic in parts of the world, the outbreak's origin has become contentious, with local authorities in one part of Argentina accusing the country's government of scapegoating the town.

Hantavirus mainly spreads to humans who come into contact with the urine, droppings or saliva of infected mice and rats.

But person-to-person spread of the Andes strain of the virus — believed to be behind the current outbreak — is possible, prompting officials to trace the Dutch couple's four-month journey through Argentina, Chile and Uruguay.

According to the WHO, the virus' incubation period is between one and six weeks.

Chilean and Uruguayan authorities have denied any link to the outbreak, given the virus' incubation period, and particular focus has fallen on Ushuaia, Argentina's southernmost city, where the MV Hondius departed from.

Affectionately known as 'the end of the world', Ushuaia is located on the island of Tierra del Fuego.

It's a key departure point for vessels heading towards Antarctica and a common stop on tours of the rugged Patagonia region.

Authorities have combed through the couple's itinerary and have suggested they may have come into contact with the virus while birdwatching at a landfill site near the city.

The Argentinian health ministry has also announced it's sending experts to the island to capture and test rodents in the area.

title.en: EU negotiators agree new rules on vital medicines
title.zh: 欧盟谈判代表就重要药品新规达成一致

summary.en: European Union negotiators have reached an agreement on new regulations aimed at addressing drug shortages across the bloc. The new rules will facilitate the use of public funds to support the production of essential medicines.
summary.zh: 欧盟谈判代表就旨在解决欧盟内部药品短缺问题的新规定达成了一致。新规将有助于利用公共资金支持基本药品的生产。

body.en:
A new agreement aims to tackle the drug shortages that have plagued the bloc. Among other things, it would make it easier to use public funds to support the production of essential medicines.

European Union negotiators on Tuesday reached an agreement  on rules that aim to bolster the bloc's supply chains for essential medicines and reduce its dependence on drug manufacturers outside the bloc.

The rules aim to combat the drug shortages that have occasionally affected the bloc in the past few years, where pharmacies have run low on certain medicines, including painkillers, antibiotics and fever medicine for children. 

"With today's agreement, we are taking practical action to reduce our vulnerabilities, diversify supply chains and strengthen Europe's capacity to produce critical medicines and their ingredients closer to home," said Cypriot Health Minister Neophytos Charalambides, whose country currently holds the rotating EU Council presidency.

Charalambides said that people should no longer have to be worried about whether they could obtain essential medicines from their pharmacy or hospital.

The agreed rules aim, among other things, to make it easier to use public funding to support the production of such medicines.

The new rules, which still require approval from EU member states and the European Parliament, foresee giving priority to medicines manufactured in Europe in cases of public procurement.

So-called strategic projects would also receive faster approval and more rapid access to funding.

The rules would also allow several countries to join together to buy important medicines, particularly those used to treat rare illnesses — an area where the market is deficient, according to the European Commission.

The Commission, which suggested amending the rules in 2025, has identified several reasons why vital medicines have at times run short in the bloc.

Among other things, it has cited bottlenecks in the supply of active ingredients.

In addition — as became particularly apparent during the coronavirus pandemic in the early 2020s — the fact that production of some medicines is concentrated in a very small number of countries can pose supply problems, it said.

EU health ministers said last year that some 80% to 90% of medicaments used in Europe come from Asia, above all China.

This is although some 900,000 people are employed in the pharmaceutical sector in the EU, according to the Commission.
body.zh: 一项新协议旨在解决困扰欧盟的药品短缺问题。除其他外，这将使公共资金更容易用于支持基本药物的生产。 欧盟谈判代表周二就旨在加强欧盟基本药物供应链并减少对欧盟以外药品制造商的依赖的规则达成协议。 这些规则旨在解决过去几年中偶尔影响到欧盟的药品短缺问题，药店的某些药品短缺，包括止痛药、抗生素和儿童退烧药。 现任欧盟理事会轮值主席国的塞浦路斯卫生部长尼奥菲托斯·查拉兰皮迪斯表示：“根据今天的协议，我们正在采取实际行动，减少我们的脆弱性，实现供应链多元化，并加强欧洲在离本土更近的地方生产关键药品及其成分的能力。” 查拉兰皮迪斯表示，人们不必再担心是否可以从药房或医院获得基本药物。 除其他外，商定的规则旨在使公共资金更容易用于支持此类药物的生产。 新规则仍需要欧盟成员国和欧洲议会的批准，预计在公共采购中将优先考虑欧洲制造的药品。 所谓的战略项目也将获得更快的批准和更快的融资。 欧盟委员会表示，这些规则还将允许多个国家联合购买重要药物，特别是用于治疗罕见疾病的药物——这是市场不足的领域。 该委员会建议在 2025 年修改规则，并确定了欧盟重要药品有时出现短缺的几个原因。 除其他外，它还提到了活性成分供应的瓶颈。 此外，报告称，某些药品的生产集中在极少数国家，这可能会造成供应问题，这一点在 2020 年代初的冠状病毒大流行期间尤为明显。 欧盟卫生部长去年表示，欧洲使用的大约80%至90%的药品来自亚洲，尤其是中国。 据欧盟委员会称，尽管欧盟制药行业雇用了约 90 万人。

reflection.en: The agreement to ensure vital medicine supply reflects a commitment to justice and mercy for all citizens. When leaders act to meet fundamental needs, they embody the call to do what is right and love mercy.
reflection.zh: 确保重要药品供应的协议，体现了对所有公民的公义与怜悯的承诺。当领导者采取行动满足基本需求时，他们就体现了行公义、好怜悯的呼召。

verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Donald Trump is set to land in China for historic talks — and he's bringing an old friend
title.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普将抵达中国进行历史性会谈——他将带一位老朋友同行

summary.en: The US president is due in Beijing on Thursday for a two-day summit with Xi Jinping.
summary.zh: 美国总统将于周四抵达北京，与习近平举行两天峰会。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump is set to visit Beijing on Thursday for a historic meeting between the world leaders, the first on Chinese soil in nearly a decade.

The 14 to 15 May meeting had originally been scheduled for March. However, US-Israeli strikes on Iran, which sparked the war in the Middle East , caused a delay in proceedings.

On the agenda is a normalisation of trade relations following a tariff war Trump announced last year , which saw import taxes rise to as high as 145 per cent. The fate of Taiwan is also likely to be discussed, as is the possible regulation of artificial intelligence.

China claims Taiwan as its own territory, which should be taken by force if necessary. Taiwan says it is an independent country and will defend its freedoms and democracy

The war in the Middle East is, however, likely to dominate. China is reportedly very concerned about the prospect of a global recession as the conflict continues to drag on, impacting energy supplies and trade.

The US is likely to request assistance from China — as the major buyer of Iranian oil — in pressuring the Middle Eastern nation to open the blockaded Strait of Hormuz .

Analysts have suggested that the meeting is unlikely to result in any major breakthroughs, although a pause in tariff escalations could be extended beyond the current October deadline.

Trump "kind of needs China more than China needs him," Alejandro Reyes, a professor specialising in Chinese foreign policy at the University of Hong Kong told the Reuters news agency.

"He needs a kind of foreign policy victory: a victory that shows that he is looking to ensure stability in the world and that he's not just disrupting global politics."

A White House official has confirmed to US broadcaster Bloomberg that Tesla boss Elon Musk and outgoing Apple CEO Tim Cook have been invited to accompany Trump during his visit to Beijing.

The invitation has been extended to other leaders in technology and finance, with representatives from asset manager BlackRock, investment bank Goldman Sachs, semi conductor coporation Qualcomm, Boeing, Meta Platforms, Mastercard, and Visa among the more than a dozen business officials requested.

The executives from some of the US' most powerful business groups could be there to encourage trade normalisation and potentially make deals with Chinese producers.

Exports of rare earth minerals to the US were temporarily halted during the trade war last year, materials that are essential for the output of US technology firms.

Musk, the outspoken billionaire who once headed Trump's so-called Department of Government Efficiency , has yet to confirm whether or not he will be attending.

Still, the invitation suggests another shift in the thawing relationship between Trump and...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将于周四访问北京，举行世界领导人之间的历史性会晤，这是近十年来首次在中国土地上举行。 5 月 14 日至 15 日的会议原定于 3 月份举行。然而，美以对伊朗的打击引发了中东战争，导致诉讼程序被推迟。 特朗普去年宣布关税战后，进口税升至 145%，之后贸易关系正常化已列入议程。台湾的命运以及人工智能的可能监管也可能会被讨论。 中国声称台湾是自己的领土，必要时应以武力夺取。台湾称其是一个独立国家并将捍卫其自由和民主 然而，中东战争很可能占据主导地位。据报道，随着冲突继续拖延，影响能源供应和贸易，中国非常担心全球经济衰退的前景。 美国可能会请求中国作为伊朗石油的主要买家提供援助，迫使这个中东国家开放被封锁的霍尔木兹海峡。 分析人士表示，尽管关税升级的暂停可能会延长到目前十月份的最后期限之后，但这次会议不太可能取得任何重大突破。 香港大学专门研究中国外交政策的教授亚历杭德罗·雷耶斯对路透社表示，特朗普“对中国的需要超过了中国对他的需要”。 “他需要一种外交政策的胜利：这种胜利表明他正在寻求确保世界稳定，而不仅仅是扰乱全球政治。” 一名白宫官员向美国广播公司彭博社证实，特斯拉老板埃隆·马斯克和即将卸任的苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克已受邀陪同特朗普访问北京。 邀请已扩展到技术和金融领域的其他领导者，其中包括资产管理公司贝莱德、投资银行高盛、半导体公司高通、波音、Meta Platforms、万事达卡和 Visa 的代表，以及十几位商界官员的要求。 美国一些最强大的商业集团的高管可能会在那里鼓励贸易正常化，并可能与中国生产商达成交易。 去年贸易战期间，稀土矿物对美国的出口暂时停止，稀土矿物对美国科技公司的产出至关重要。 曾经领导特朗普所谓的政府效率部的直言不讳的亿万富翁马斯克尚未确认他是否会出席。 尽管如此，这次邀请表明特朗普和……之间解冻的关系发生了另一个转变。

reflection.en: High-level diplomatic meetings like this summit underscore the ongoing effort required to maintain peace and stability between nations. Romans 12:18 reminds us of the personal and collective responsibility to pursue peaceful coexistence, "If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone." Such talks are a vital expression of this...
reflection.zh: 像这次峰会这样的高层外交会议，强调了维持国家间和平与稳定所需的持续努力。罗马书12:18提醒我们，个人和集体都有责任追求和平共处：“若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。” 这样的会谈是这种承诺在全球舞台上的重要体现。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Last passengers leave virus-hit cruise ship as three more test positive
title.zh: 病毒感染邮轮最后乘客撤离，另有三人检测呈阳性

summary.en: An American and a French national who have returned home have tested positive for hantavirus after leaving a virus-hit cruise ship.
summary.zh: 一艘受病毒影响的邮轮上，最后一批乘客已撤离，其中一名美国人和一名法国国民在回国后被检测出汉坦病毒呈阳性。

body.en:
The last passengers have left the hantavirus-hit cruise ship, as authorities confirmed three new positive cases linked to the deadly outbreak.

The MV Hondius departed Tenerife for the Netherlands on Monday after its final six passengers - four Australians, one Briton and one New Zealander - and some crew members disembarked.

Three passengers have died after travelling on the ship, two of whom were confirmed to have had the virus.

An American and a French national who had previously returned home have tested positive, authorities said. Seven cases of hantavirus linked to the MV Hondius have been confirmed, with two others suspected, according to the World Health Organization (WHO).

Spain's health ministry said one Spaniard who is quarantining in Madrid after being evacuated from the vessel had also provisionally tested positive for hantavirus on Monday.

On Monday, the US health department said a second American national on Sunday's repatriation flight had also shown mild symptoms, adding that both passengers had travelled back in "biocontainment units out of an abundance of caution".

French Health Minister Stéphanie Rist said a woman was isolating in Paris and that her health was deteriorating, with 22 contacts traced.

Two British nationals with confirmed cases are currently being treated in the Netherlands and South Africa.

Seventeen Filipino crew members of the MV Hondius arrived in the Netherlands on Tuesday morning, according to the Philippine Embassy. Four crew members arrived earlier on Sunday evening.

The embassy said the crew underwent medical testing and will be quarantined in local facilities.

In total there are 38 Filipino crew members that require eventual repatriation to the Philippines, the embassy added.

Hantaviruses are usually carried by rodents , but human transmission of the Andes strain - which the WHO believes some of the ship's passengers contracted in South America - is possible.

Symptoms can include fever, extreme fatigue, muscle aches, stomach pain, vomiting, diarrhoea and shortness of breath.

As of Monday evening, the ship's operator Oceanwide Expeditions said 27 people remain on board the ship, including 25 crew members and two medical staff.

These include 17 people from the Philippines, four from the Netherlands (including the two medical staff), four from Ukraine, one from Russia and one from Poland.

Ukraine's foreign ministry said the Ukrainians on board would help with the ships transfer to the Netherlands and would quarantine at a medical facility on arrival. It added that they had shown no signs of illness.

More than 90 passengers of the MV Hondius, which was docked in Spain's Canary Islands, have been repatriated over the past few days.

reflection.en: News of a virus outbreak reminds us of our shared human vulnerability to illness and disease. In such times, we are called to remember those who are sick and to offer our prayers for their healing and recovery.

title.en: US: LA area mayor to plead guilty to acting as Chinese agent
title.zh: 美国：洛杉矶地区市长将承认充当中国代理人

summary.en: The mayor of a Los Angeles suburb with a heavy Chinese-American presence has resigned after admitting to acting as a Chinese propaganda agent. Eileen Wang now faces a maximum penalty of 10 years in jail.
summary.zh: 一位洛杉矶郊区的市长已辞职，并将承认充当中国宣传代理人。王艾琳承认了这些行为，可能面临最高10年的监禁。

body.en:
The mayor of a Los Angeles suburb with a heavy Chinese-American presence has resigned after admitting to acting as a Chinese propaganda agent. Eileen Wang now faces a maximum penalty of 10 years in jail.

A mayor of a city in Southern California has agreed to plead guilty to a charge of acting as a foreign agent of the Chinese government , US officials said on Monday.

Eileen Wang, the mayor of Arcadia, was charged in April to a single felony count of acting in the United States as an illegal agent of a foreign government , the US Attorney's Office in the Central District of California said on Monday.

Wang resigned as mayor within hours of her case being made public, Arcadia City Council's website showed.

She was elected to a five-person city council in November 2022 and assumed the position of mayor in February, on a rotating basis.

Arcadia is a heavily Chinese-American suburb, situated just north of Los Angeles. The city is home to some 53,000 residents.

According to her plea agreement, Wang and a colleague, Yaoning "Mike" Sun, promoted propaganda favorable to China "at the direction ‌and ​control" of Chinese government officials from late 2020 to 2022.

The duo operated the news website US News Center — which served the local Chinese-American community — and promoted pro-Chinese propaganda through it, according to the Justice Department.

"Wang and Sun received and executed directives from [Chinese] government officials to post [pro-Chinese] content on the website," the department said.

According to the court filing, the pro-China content published on the site included articles disputing reports of the persecution, forced labor, and abuse of ethnic Uyghurs in China's Xinjiang ⁠region .

Sun pleaded guilty in October 2025 to the same charge as Wang and is serving a four-year prison sentence.

The 68-year-old was also listed in campaign filings as the treasurer for Wang's 2022 election campaign.

Prosecutors have also alleged that Wang communicated with a ⁠Chinese Communist Party figure named John Chen, who had also pleaded guilty to being an agent for the Chinese government and was sentenced to 20 months in prison in 2024.

In that same year, Wang Shujun, a Chinese-American academic , was convicted of acting as a China’s foreign agent. Prosecutors proved he shared sensitive information with Beijing's Ministry of State Security (MSS).

A US national of Chinese origin was also accused of spying on Chinese dissidents for the MSS. He had taken part in China's 1989 pro-democracy movement and was later granted US asylum.

On Monday, Wang's attorneys Jason Liang and Brian Sun said in a statement that she recognizes the seriousness of the charge and accepts responsibility for "past personal mistakes."

title.en: Ex-Philippine leader Duterte's drug war enforcer escapes ICC arrest
title.zh: 菲律宾前领导人杜特尔特禁毒战执行者逃脱国际刑事法院逮捕

summary.en: Senator Ronald "Bato" Dela Rosa, a former national police chief, has sought refuge in the senate to avoid arrest by the International Criminal Court (ICC).
summary.zh: 曾任国家警察局长的参议员罗纳德·“巴托”·德拉罗萨已在参议院寻求庇护，以避免被国际刑事法院逮捕。

body.en:
A Filipino senator who oversaw former president Rodrigo Duterte's deadly war on drugs has taken refuge inside the country's Senate, hours before the International Criminal Court unsealed a warrant for his arrest.

Ronald Dela Rosa was pictured fleeing into the Senate on Monday as officers chased after him. He narrowly escaped and was placed under protective custody.

Police later said they would not arrest him while he was in custody of the Senate.

Dela Rosa is accused of the killing of at least 32 people between 2016 and 2018, as an "indirect co-perpetrator" in Duterte's anti-drugs campaign, in which thousands of alleged drug dealers were shot and killed.

Former president Duterte has been in ICC custody in The Hague since his arrest in March 2025.

Security camera footage played to lawmakers on Monday showed National Bureau of Investigation agents chasing Dela Rosa up flights of stairs and a corridor in the Senate building after he arrived.

An ensuing standoff ended hours later with the chief of the National Bureau of Investigation telling reporters that they would not arrest Dela Rosa while he was in the custody of the Senate.

Dela Rosa has said that he would remain within the Senate's premises and "do everything" to avoid being taken to the Hague.

His lawyers say they have asked the Supreme Court to block his arrest in the absence of a valid Philippine judicial warrant.

On Tuesday morning, Dela Rosa urged his supporters, who have gathered outside the Senate building, to "keep vigil in front of the Senate until the Supreme Court decides".

He also called on Philippine Ferdinand Marcos Jr, who is feuding with the Duterte political dynasty, to file a local case against him if he believed him to be guilty.

"If I have an obligation, I will answer it in the local court, not a foreign one," he told reporters.

The chaos that has gripped the Senate comes as its 24 members, dominated by Duterte's allies, elected a new president on Monday.

The new senate president, Alan Peter Cayetano, told reporters that the chamber would only act on arrest warrants from a Philippine court.

But it is Marcos's allies who control the lower House of Representatives, which earlier in the day voted to impeach Duterte's daughter Sara, the current vice-president, for the second time .

The feud between the Duterte and Marcos dynasties has become increasingly bitter, after the collapse of the alliance which helped them to win the 2022 election.

Sara Duterte is the front-runner to succeed President Marcos in the next election in two years' time, and she accuses him of using the ICC arrest warrants and her impeachment as political weapons to weaken her campaign.

title.en: 'Brutal oppression': Australian government imposes new sanctions on Iranian officials
title.zh: “残酷压迫”：澳大利亚政府对伊朗官员实施新制裁

summary.en: The Australian government has imposed new sanctions on Iranian officials, citing "brutal oppression" and bringing the total number of sanctions on Iranian individuals and entities to over 230.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚政府以“残酷压迫”为由，对伊朗官员实施了新的制裁，至此对伊朗个人和实体的制裁总数已超过230项。

body.en:
Australia is imposing targeted financial penalties and travel bans on senior Iranian officials responsible for the oppression of women and girls under the regime's crackdown on society.

Seven Iranians and four entities are being sanctioned in response to Iran's "brutal" ongoing oppression of its people, in addition to the wrongful detention of foreigners, Foreign Minister Penny Wong announced on Tuesday.

Independent estimates suggest Iranian forces killed more than 30,000 people as protests erupted throughout the country in January. Iranian government figures put that number much lower.

The sanctioned officials included interior minister Eskandar Momeni, who is also deputy commander in chief of the law enforcement forces, which is responsible for the deaths of the protesters .

Ruhollah Nasab is another high-ranking official targeted by Australia's sanctions, for his role in deploying 80,000 forces to ensure mandatory hijab-wearing by Iranian women and surveil their dress in schools, universities, public spaces and online.

The sanctions will also target Iran's shadow banking system, which allows it to fund proxies such as Hamas — which Australia considers a terrorist organisation — and support its ballistic missile program.

The Albanese government has so far imposed more than 230 sanctions on Iranian individuals and entities.

The announcement on Tuesday was made alongside the United Kingdom's sanctions on Iran.

Wong said Australia will continue its work with international partners to hold the regime to account for its "egregious campaign of oppression and destabilisation".

"Australia continues to stand with the brave people of Iran against a brutal, oppressive regime," she said.

Although the sanctions target Iran's destabilising actions throughout the Middle East, they are not in direct response to the retaliatory strikes in the US-led war.

The strikes launched by the US and Israel have resulted in the effective closure of one of the world's most important oil corridors, the Strait of Hormuz, sending the price of fuel soaring globally.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 澳大利亚正在对伊朗高级官员实施有针对性的经济处罚和旅行禁令，这些官员应对伊朗政权对社会的镇压中压迫妇女和女孩负责。 外交部长黄英贤周二宣布，除了错误拘留外国人外，七名伊朗人和四个实体正在受到制裁，以回应伊朗对其人民持续的“残酷”压迫。 独立估计显示，1 月份全国各地爆发抗议活动时，伊朗军队已造成 30,000 多人死亡。伊朗政府的数据显示这个数字要低得多。 受到制裁的官员包括内政部长埃斯坎达尔·莫梅尼(Eskandar Momeni)，他也是执法部队的副总司令，该部队对抗议者的死亡负有责任。 鲁霍拉·纳萨布 (Ruhollah Nasab) 是另一位受到澳大利亚制裁的高级官员，因为他部署了 80,000 名军队，确保伊朗妇女强制戴头巾，并在学校、大学、公共场所和网络上监控她们的着装。 制裁还将针对伊朗的影子银行系统，该系统使其能够为哈马斯（澳大利亚视为恐怖组织）等代理人提供资金，并支持其弹道导弹计划。 阿尔巴尼亚政府迄今已对伊朗个人和实体实施了230多项制裁。 周二宣布这一消息的同时，英国也对伊朗实施了制裁。 黄说，澳大利亚将继续与国际伙伴合作，追究该政权“恶劣的镇压和破坏稳定活动”的责任。 她说：“澳大利亚继续与勇敢的伊朗人民站在一起，反对残暴、压迫的政权。” 尽管制裁针对的是伊朗在整个中东地区的破坏稳定行为，但它们并不是对美国领导的战争中的报复性打击的直接回应。 美国和以色列发动的袭击导致世界上最重要的石油走廊之一霍尔木兹海峡被有效关闭，导致全球燃油价格飙升。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: When leaders govern with brutality, it is the people who bear the heaviest burden, often groaning under the weight of injustice. This news reminds us of the profound impact that governance has on human dignity and well-being. May we pray for those who suffer under oppression and for leaders to rule with righteousness.
reflection.zh: 当统治者以残暴治理时，人民承受着最沉重的负担，常常在不公的重压下呻吟。这则新闻提醒我们，治理对人类尊严和福祉有着深远的影响。愿我们为那些在压迫下受苦的人祷告，也为统治者能以公义治理而祈求。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: Ukrainian children held in Russia: militarized, 'reeducated'
title.zh: 被俄罗斯扣押的乌克兰儿童：军事化，被“再教育”

summary.en: A Ukrainian initiative to repatriate abducted Ukrainian children reports that at least 20,000 girls and boys are being held by Russian families and authorities, raising concerns about their potential repatriation.
summary.zh: 乌克兰一项旨在遣返被绑架乌克兰儿童的倡议报告称，至少有2万名乌克兰女孩和男孩被俄罗斯家庭和当局扣押，人们担忧这些孩子能否找到回家的路。

body.en:
A Ukrainian initiative to repatriate abducted Ukrainian children reports that at least 20,000 girls and boys are being held by Russian families and authorities. Can these children ever find their way home?

In March, the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on Ukraine of the UN Human Rights Council found that Russia had systematically deported and forcibly transferred Ukrainian children. These activities violate international human rights laws provisions and are classified as war crimes as well as crimes against humanity . 

It also found that Russian authorities had "unjustifiably delayed" the repatriation of Ukrainian children, which counts as a separate war crime.

Bring Kids Back UA, an initiative by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy , says it has records on about 20,570 abducted Ukrainian children .

"And those are just the cases we have more or less sufficient data on," project leader Maksym Maksymov told DW. "The true number is likely much higher."

Statements by Russian authorities appear to back this claim. In 2023, for example, Russia disclosed that it had "received" 744,000 children. That same year, Maksymov told DW, Russia reported to the United Nations Committee on the Rights of the Child that 46,000 Ukrainian children had received Russian passports.

The numbers are difficult to verify, and media reports vary widely. Children who have been successfully repatriated to Ukraine will sometimes speak of other missing children not recorded in Ukraine's database.

Identifying children and determining their whereabouts is additionally complicated by the lack of access to Russian-occupied Ukrainian territory.

"Russian authorities are arranging for children to be placed in the long-term care of Russian families and facilities," the office of Ukraine's prosecutor general told DW. "In doing so, they are violating international law which recognizes the right to reunification of families who have been separated in an armed conflict."

So far, Ukraine has managed to track down and bring back 2,126 children that had either been deported to Russia, forcibly transferred within occupied territory, or subjected to Russian "reeducation."

Maksymov described two mechanisms for repatriating abducted Ukrainian children. One is through mediation, in which case Russian authorities receive lists with names of Ukrainian children and a human rights commissioner then negotiates their return to Ukraine.

However, Maksymov says, "each mediation only helps us return no more than ten children at once."

A second avenue is "organized repatriation." Civil society groups play a large role in this, Maksymov says.

body.zh: 乌克兰一项遣返被绑架乌克兰儿童的倡议报告称，至少有 20,000 名男孩和女孩被俄罗斯家庭和当局关押。这些孩子能找到回家的路吗？ 今年3月，联合国人权理事会乌克兰问题独立国际调查委员会发现，俄罗斯有系统地驱逐和强行转移乌克兰儿童。这些活动违反了国际人权法的规定，被列为战争罪和反人类罪。 它还发现俄罗斯当局“无理拖延”乌克兰儿童的遣返，这被视为一项单独的战争罪。 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基发起的“带孩子回来”倡议称，该组织拥有约 20,570 名被绑架的乌克兰儿童的记录。 项目负责人马克西姆·马克西莫夫 (Maksym Maksymov) 告诉德国之声：“这些只是我们或多或少拥有足够数据的案例。” “真实数字可能要高得多。” 俄罗斯当局的声明似乎支持了这一说法。例如，2023 年，俄罗斯披露其“接收”了 744,000 名儿童。同年，马克西莫夫告诉德国之声，俄罗斯向联合国儿童权利委员会报告称，46,000 名乌克兰儿童获得了俄罗斯护照。 这些数字很难核实，媒体报道也千差万别。成功遣返乌克兰的儿童有时会谈到乌克兰数据库中未记录的其他失踪儿童。 由于无法进入俄罗斯占领的乌克兰领土，识别儿童身份并确定他们的下落也变得更加复杂。 乌克兰总检察长办公室告诉德国之声：“俄罗斯当局正在安排将儿童安置在俄罗斯家庭和设施中进行长期护理。” “他们这样做违反了国际法，国际法承认在武装冲突中离散的家庭有团聚的权利。” 到目前为止，乌克兰已成功追查并带回2126名儿童，他们要么被驱逐到俄罗斯，要么被强行转移到被占领土，要么接受俄罗斯“再教育”。 马克西莫夫描述了两种遣返被绑架乌克兰儿童的机制。一种是通过调解，在这种情况下，俄罗斯当局收到载有乌克兰儿童姓名的名单，然后人权专员就他们返回乌克兰进行谈判。 然而，马克西莫夫说，“每次调解只能帮助我们一次送回不超过十个孩子。” 第二条途径是“有组织的遣返”。 马克西莫夫说，民间社会团体在这方面发挥着重要作用。 “有时这种方法可以一次性带回更多的孩子，但我不被允许……

title.en: The 48-hour deadline DFAT faces for Australians returning from hantavirus-hit cruise
title.zh: 法国和西班牙汉坦病毒撤离者检测呈阳性，澳大利亚人正在回国

summary.en: Four Australians, a New Zealand citizen, and one permanent resident who were evacuated from France and Spain due to potential hantavirus exposure have tested positive. They will now spend three weeks in a quarantine facility near Perth upon their return to Australia.
summary.zh: 四名澳大利亚人、一名新西兰公民和一名永久居民因可能接触汉坦病毒而从法国和西班牙撤离，现已检测呈阳性。他们回国后将在珀斯附近的一个隔离设施中度过三周。

body.en:
A cruise ship hit by a deadly hantavirus outbreak left Spain's Canary Islands on Tuesday, after the last passengers on board, including four Australians, arrived in the Netherlands to await travel plans to head home.

The last two evacuation planes carrying passengers and crew from the hantavirus-hit ship MV Hondius landed in the Netherlands on Tuesday, according to an Agence France-Presse (AFP) journalist.

Travelling in the two planes were 28 evacuees from the ship, according to the Dutch foreign ministry, including passengers, crew, and medical staff.

The first plane to land was transporting six former guests of the Hondius, four from Australia, one from New Zealand, and one British person who lives in Australia.

These six are expected to stay in a quarantine facility close to the airport before being flown to Australia.

Health Minister Mark Butler told reporters on Tuesday the group was in "good health and relatively good spirits".

The Australian government has been given 48 hours by the Netherlands to evacuate the six passengers, a deadline Butler was "confident" his government would meet, even though a plane and crew were yet to be acquired.

He said that the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade was in the process of finalising the group's flight details.

"These are complex arrangements, given the distance between the Netherlands and Australia, and also the requirement to find a company willing to charter a flight that will be subject to, obviously, quite strict hygiene requirements ... and for it to be crewed by crew who are willing to undertake isolation," Butler said.

He said the evacuees and crew operating the repatriation flight will land at an RAF base near Perth, and will then be taken to the Bullsbrook Centre for National Resilience for a three-week quarantine.

Butler announced that hantavirus had also been listed under the Biosecurity Act, giving the government the power to mandate quarantine requirements.

The six passengers and repatriation crew would be looked after by staff from the National Critical Care and Trauma Response Centre, a Commonwealth team based in Darwin.

He said WA Health staff would not be involved in their care, unless they were to become very ill and needed to be treated by a Perth Hospital.

Three people died after the rare virus that usually spreads among rodents was detected on board the MV Hondius, sparking a global health scare.

No vaccines or specific treatments exist for the virus, but health officials have insisted the risk to the public is low and dismissed comparisons to the COVID-19 pandemic.

The ship set off from Tenerife on Tuesday after the last 28 people were taken off, according to AFP reporters at the scene.

body.zh: MV Hondius 号的疏散工作十分复杂，共有来自 19 个不同国籍的 94 人从悬挂荷兰国旗的船上撤离。资料来源：AAP / 阿图罗·罗德里格斯 / 美联社 周二，一艘遭受致命汉坦病毒爆发的游轮从西班牙加那利群岛出发前往荷兰，船上最后一批乘客（包括四名澳大利亚人）下船并乘飞机回国接受隔离。 MV Hondius 船上检测到通常在啮齿类动物中传播的罕见病毒，导致三人死亡，引发全球健康恐慌。 目前尚无针对该病毒的疫苗或具体治疗方法，但卫生官员坚称该病毒对公众构成的风险较低，并没有与 COVID-19 大流行进行比较。 据现场法新社记者报道，最后 28 名乘客被救下后，这艘船于周二从特内里费岛出发。 邮轮运营商 Oceanwide Expeditions 在一份声明中表示：“MV Hondius 预计需要六天时间才能抵达鹿特丹。” 船上有25名船员和两名医务人员，还载着一名在航行中死亡的德国乘客的尸体。 周一，经过复杂的疏散程序，来自 19 个不同国籍的 94 人从这艘悬挂荷兰国旗的船上被带走。 西班牙当局表示，这艘船原本只是出于健康和安全原因才被授权在近海抛锚，但由于天气不利而停靠在港口。 法新社记者在特内里费岛格拉纳迪拉的小型工业港口看到，工人们正在将一条走道连接到船上，人们在离开船只前往遣返航班的途中。 西班牙中央政府强调，不会与民众接触。 最后的撤离人员包括澳大利亚人、新西兰人、英国人和船员。四名澳大利亚撤离人员、一名新西兰人和一名永久居民将乘坐政府支持的包机前往澳大利亚，然后在珀斯郊外的一个设施中接受隔离三周。 卫生部长斯蒂芬妮·里斯特表示，在已完成的遣返中，一名法国妇女周一开始感到不适，她是在巴黎隔离的五名法国撤离人员之一，“检测结果呈阳性”。 马德里卫生部表示，一名西班牙乘客的检测结果也呈阳性，并补充说，其他 13 名西班牙撤离人员的检测结果迄今为止呈阴性。 周一，美国卫生部门表示，从船上撤离的一名美国国民有“轻微症状”，另一名美国人的安第斯病毒检测呈阳性，这是唯一可在人与人之间传播的汉坦病毒株。 荷兰一家医院的 12 名工作人员正在治疗一名检测结果呈阳性的撤离者，同时由于采血和处理血液的程序错误而处于预防性隔离状态。

reflection.en: News of a potential virus exposure and subsequent quarantine reminds us of our vulnerability to illness and the importance of community care. In times of health concerns, we are called to pray for those affected and for the wisdom of those working to protect public well-being.
reflection.zh: 潜在病毒暴露和随后的隔离新闻提醒我们，人类在疾病面前是脆弱的，社区关怀至关重要。在健康担忧时期，我们蒙召为受影响的人祷告，也为那些致力于保护公众健康的人们祷告，求雅伟赐予他们智慧。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: Religion steers Bengal politics in Bangladesh, India — again
title.zh: 宗教再次主导孟加拉国和印度的孟加拉地区政治

summary.en: Bengal, a region historically known for its secular traditions, is experiencing a growing influence of religion in politics. This trend is marked by the increasing strength of Islamists in Bangladesh and the Hindu nationalist BJP gaining power in India's West Bengal.
summary.zh: 孟加拉地区以其世俗传统而闻名，但目前正经历着宗教在政治中日益增长的影响力。这一趋势的特点是孟加拉国境内的伊斯兰主义者势力增强，以及印度西孟加拉邦的印度教民族主义政党印度人民党掌权。

body.en:
Bengal, a region known for its secular traditions, is seeing a rise of religion in politics as Islamists grow stronger on the Bangladesh side of the border and Hindu nationalist BJP takes power in India's West Bengal.

Religious and ethnic divisions are growing deeper in Bengal, a region divided between India and Bangladesh. Politicians on both sides of the border are seeking to capitalize on religious sentiment.

In Bangladesh, the February parliamentary elections marked a major moment for Islamist politics , with Jamaat-e-Islami winning nearly one third of the votes nationwide — its strongest showing yet.

In India's West Bengal, the  Hindu nationalist BJP surged from about 10% vote share in 2016 to nearly 46% this year. Under the state's "first past the post" electoral system, this was enough for the BJP to secure 207 out of 294 seats in the state assembly last month .

Bangladeshi anthropologist Rezwana Karim Snigdha warns of an "ill-motivated" shift in rhetorics in Bengal.

The region once boasted a "shared identity" which "allowed people to be both Bengali and Hindu, or Bengali and Muslim," she told DW. "But on both sides of the border, political narratives are increasingly framing identity in religious terms, sidelining language, culture and heritage."

Bengal, broadly the land of Bengali-speaking people, has been divided several times over the centuries, most notably in 1905 when British rulers under Viceroy Lord Curzon split the Bengal Presidency along religious lines.

At the time, Bengal was the center of anti-colonial resistance, and the partition aimed to break this unity by setting the Hindu-majority west against the Muslim-majority east. London hoped to undermine the growing nationalist movement before it could seriously challenge British rule.

Muslim Bengalis in the east, centered around Dhaka, largely welcomed the 1905 partition as it created a region where they would form a majority. In contrast, many Hindu elites opposed the move, seeing it as a threat to their political influence, economic interests and cultural identity.

Indian historian and postcolonial theorist Dipesh Chakrabarty says the "divide and rule" strategy introduced by the British over a century ago still shapes the region today.

"The Hindu elites failed to grasp the moment," he told DW. "Accepting the partition might have reassured Muslims that they were not being dominated."

Strong opposition forced the British to reverse the 1905 partition in 1911, but the underlying divisions persisted. They resurfaced in 1947, when Bengal was split again — this time permanently — between Hindu-majority India and Muslim-majority then East Pakistan.

body.zh: 孟加拉是一个以其世俗传统而闻名的地区，随着伊斯兰主义者在孟加拉边境一侧日益强大，以及印度民族主义人民党在印度西孟加拉邦掌权，宗教在政治中的崛起。 孟加拉地区的宗教和种族分歧日益加深，该地区分为印度和孟加拉国。边境两侧的政治家都在寻求利用宗教情绪。 在孟加拉国，二月份的议会选举标志着伊斯兰政治的一个重要时刻，伊斯兰大会党赢得了全国近三分之一的选票——这是迄今为止最强劲的表现。 在印度西孟加拉邦，印度教民族主义政党印度人民党的得票率从 2016 年的约 10% 飙升至今年的近 46%。根据该邦的“优先当选”选举制度，这足以让印度人民党在上个月的邦议会294个席位中获得207个席位。 孟加拉国人类学家雷兹瓦纳·卡里姆·斯尼格达警告说，孟加拉的言论出现了“动机不良”的转变。 她告诉德国之声，该地区曾经拥有“共同的身份”，“允许人们既是孟加拉人又是印度教徒，或者是孟加拉人和穆斯林”。 “但在边境两侧，政治叙事越来越多地用宗教术语来塑造身份，将语言、文化和遗产边缘化。” 孟加拉是孟加拉语人民的土地，几个世纪以来曾多次分裂，最引人注目的是 1905 年总督寇松勋爵领导下的英国统治者根据宗教信仰分裂了孟加拉总统职位。 当时，孟加拉是反殖民抵抗的中心，分治的目的是通过让印度教徒占多数的西部与穆斯林占多数的东部对抗来打破这种团结。伦敦希望在民族主义运动严重挑战英国统治之前削弱它。 以达卡为中心的东部孟加拉穆斯林在很大程度上欢迎 1905 年的分治，因为它创造了一个他们将占多数的地区。相比之下，许多印度教精英反对此举，认为这是对其政治影响力、经济利益和文化认同的威胁。 印度历史学家和后殖民理论家迪佩什·查克拉巴蒂 (Dipesh Chakrabarty) 表示，英国一个多世纪前推行的“分而治之”战略至今仍在影响着该地区。 “印度教精英未能抓住时机，”他告诉德国之声。 “接受分治可能会让穆斯林放心，他们没有被统治。” 强烈的反对迫使英国于 1911 年推翻了 1905 年的分治，但潜在的分歧仍然存在。 1947 年，它们再次出现，当时孟加拉再次分裂——这一次是永久性的——划分为印度教徒占多数的印度和当时穆斯林占多数的东巴基斯坦。 孟加拉国于 1947 年建国时原本是巴基斯坦的一部分。几年之内，孟加拉穆斯林开始...

reflection.en: The rise of religious nationalism in Bengal highlights the complex interplay between faith and governance. When political power becomes intertwined with a singular religious or national identity, there is a risk of elevating an ideology above universal human dignity and the divine. This reminds us to examine where our ultimate allegiance lies, ensuring no...
reflection.zh: 孟加拉地区宗教民族主义的兴起，凸显了信仰与治理之间复杂的相互作用。当政治权力与单一的宗教或民族认同纠缠不清时，存在将某种意识形态凌驾于普世人性尊严和神圣之上的风险。这提醒我们审视我们最终的忠诚所在，确保没有任何世俗权力或身份取代雅伟的地位。

title.en: Ciao UFO review – Hong Kong tear-jerker is less ET than time-hopping chronicle of housing estate kids
title.zh: 《再见UFO》影评：香港催泪片，与其说是外星人故事，不如说是屋邨孩童的时光编年史

summary.en: In 1985, four working-class characters in Hong Kong are bonded forever by a strange sighting in this sentimental saga that tracks their lives into adulthood, directed by Patrick Leung.
summary.zh: 这部由梁柏坚执导的感人电影讲述了1985年香港四位工薪阶层角色因一次奇特目击事件而永远结缘，并追溯了他们从童年到成年的生活轨迹。

body.en: In 1985, four working-class characters are bonded for ever by a strange sighting in this sentimental saga that tracks their lives into adulthood Directed by Patrick Leung, this affecting saga from Hong Kong is a bit tricksy to get to grips with because it keeps hopping back and forth between an assortment of time frames. It tracks a set of characters as children in the mid-1980s, played by one group of young actors, and then later in the 1990s and early 00s when an adult cast takes over. But as it spirals in towards its surprising and dramatic conclusion, everything falls into place and the last 10 minutes is properly tear-jerking – even if it’s unabashedly sentimental, like a classic melodrama. The key incident foretold in the title happens around halfway through, although it’s no spoiler to know it’s coming. In 1985, a quartet of kids growing up on a working-class Hong Kong housing estate – boys Kin (Matthew Wong Cheuk-yin) and Heem (Chui Ka-him), and girl Hoyi (Lam Seung-yu) and her kid brother (Shawn Heung Sung-yu), for ever called Little Brother – see a UFO in the sky one night. The experience bonds them for ever, even if each kid grows up to pursue goals one wouldn’t expect based on what they’re like as tots. Sailor’s son Kin (played by Chui Tien-you as an adult) pursues wealth in the stock market as it booms in the aftermath of the 1997 handover of Hong Kong to China, itself an understandably big deal in the story. Heem (a very engaging Wong You-nam) had leukaemia as a child, and lives constantly in the short term under the shadow of illness. Hoyi, who everyone describes as a pudgy little girl, grows up to be a slim-hipped beauty (Charlene Choi Cheuk-yin) – this is considered a great achievement along with becoming an accountant and planning to marry a dullard named Austin (Joey Cho Yiu Leung) who has his life all planned out. Continue reading...
body.zh: 1985 年，在这部感伤的传奇故事中，四个工人阶级的角色因一次奇怪的景象而永远联系在一起，这部感伤的传奇故事讲述了他们的成年生活。这部由梁志强执导的感人的香港传奇故事有点难以掌握，因为它不断在不同的时间框架之间来回跳跃。它追踪了 20 世纪 80 年代中期由一群年轻演员扮演的一组儿童角色，以及 20 世纪 90 年代后期和 00 年代初由成人演员扮演的角色。但当故事螺旋式地走向令人惊讶和戏剧性的结局时，一切都水到渠成，最后 10 分钟恰到好处地催人泪下——尽管它毫不掩饰感伤，就像一部经典的情节剧。标题中预言的关键事件发生在故事的一半左右，尽管知道它即将发生并不是剧透。 1985 年，在香港工薪阶层住宅区长大的四名孩子——男孩健（黄卓贤饰）和 Heem（徐家谦饰）、女孩浩仪（林升宇饰）和她永远被称为“小兄弟”的弟弟（向崇宇饰）——一天晚上在天空中看到了不明飞行物。这段经历将他们永远联系在一起，即使每个孩子长大后都会追求一些人们无法想象的目标，因为他们小时候的样子。 1997 年香港回归中国后，股市蓬勃发展，水手的儿子健（成年后由崔天佑饰演）在股市中追逐财富，这本身就是故事中的一件大事，这是可以理解的。希姆（非常有魅力的黄又南饰）小时候患有白血病，短期内一直生活在疾病的阴影下。被大家形容为矮胖小女孩的浩仪，长大后却是一个纤细臀部的美女（蔡卓妍饰），这在成为一名会计师，并准备嫁给一个生活已被规划好的呆子奥斯汀（曹耀梁饰）的同时，也算得上是一项伟大的成就。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film's "time-hopping chronicle" of lives unfolding from childhood into adulthood beautifully illustrates that "for everything there is a season, and a time for every matter under heaven." The shared, strange sighting becomes a defining moment, marking a unique season that forever shapes their individual journeys and enduring bonds. It reminds us that...
reflection.zh: 这部电影以“时光编年史”的方式，展现了主人公们从童年到成年的生活轨迹，恰好印证了“凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时”的智慧。那次共同的奇特目击事件，成为了他们生命中一个独特的季节，永远塑造了他们的个人旅程和持久的羁绊。它提醒我们，生命是一幅由不同时期编织而成的挂毯，每个时期都塑造着我们成为怎样的人。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
verse.textZh: 凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时。

title.en: Elon Musk and Tim Cook among CEOs expected to accompany Trump on China trip
title.zh: 特朗普访华，埃隆·马斯克和蒂姆·库克等首席执行官预计随行

summary.en: Seventeen US executives, including Elon Musk and Tim Cook, are expected to accompany the president on his trip to China, where he will meet with his Chinese counterpart, Xi Jinping.
summary.zh: 包括埃隆·马斯克和蒂姆·库克在内的17位美国企业高管预计将随同总统访问中国，届时总统将与中国国家主席习近平会晤。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump is expected to bring a host of top business and technology industry executives on his trip to China this week.

Among those set to join the president on his official trip to Beijing are Tim Cook of Apple, Elon Musk of Tesla and SpaceX, Larry Fink of BlackRock, as well as other executives from Meta, Visa, JP Morgan, Boeing, Cargill and more.

In total, 17 US executives will join Trump on the trip, a White House official with knowledge of the plans told the BBC.

The trip is seen as important for the US, as Trump will meet with President Xi Jinping at a time of growing economic and technological animosity between the two countries.

Absent from the list is Nvidia boss Jensen Huang, whose company is central to the rivalry between the US and China over computer chips and artificial intelligence (AI).

The BBC has contacted Nvidia for comment. Last week, Huang told business news channel CNBC that it would be a "privilege" to represent the US in China if he was invited on the trip.

It is also notable that Sanjay Mehrotra, the CEO of Micron Technology, will be part of Trump's delegation.

His presence is interesting as Beijing restricted the use of some Micron chips in critical infrastructure in 2023 on national security grounds - a move the firm has said negatively impacted its business in China.

Semiconductors remain central to the US-China economic relationship, despite ongoing tensions over technology and export controls.

Chuck Robbins, chief executive and chairman of Cisco, had been invited to be a part of the trip "but is unable to due to earnings," according to a company spokeswoman.

Together, the executives represent a swath of US business interests, from social media and consumer hardware, to computer chips and commercial manufacturing.

A spokeswoman for Illumina, a biotechnology company based in Californa, said Thaysen "is honored to be part of the delegation" and that the company hopes the trip will be "an opportunity to strengthen relationships and shape the future of precision medicine."

Representatives of the other companies did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

Trump's visit to China will be the first by a US president in nearly a decade and marks a key test of a fragile trade truce between the two countries, following a tit-for-tat trade war which saw them roll out tariffs which at times topped 100%.

The tariffs were paused in October 2025 after Trump's last meeting with Xi, which took place in South Korea.

Looming large over the upcoming meeting will be the US and Israel's war in Iran , which has already forced a delay to Trump and Xi's meeting.

body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普本周预计将携带一批商业和科技行业的高级管理人员访问中国。 即将随总统正式访问北京的人士包括苹果公司的蒂姆·库克、特斯拉和 SpaceX 的埃隆·马斯克、贝莱德的拉里·芬克，以及来自 Meta、Visa、摩根大通、波音、嘉吉等公司的其他高管。 一位了解该计划的白宫官员告诉 BBC，总共有 17 名美国高管将与特朗普一起出访。 这次访问对美国来说非常重要，因为特朗普将在两国经济和技术敌意日益加剧之际会见习近平主席。 值得注意的是，英伟达(Nvidia)老板黄仁勋(Jensen Huang)并未出现在这份名单中，他的公司是中美计算机芯片和人工智能(AI)竞争的核心。 BBC 已联系 Nvidia 请其置评。上周，黄向商业新闻频道 CNBC 表示，如果他受邀访问中国，代表美国访问中国将是一种“荣幸”。 思科公司发言人表示，思科首席执行官兼董事长查克·罗宾斯曾受邀参加此次旅行，“但由于盈利原因未能成行”。 这些高管共同代表了美国的一系列商业利益，从社交媒体和消费硬件到计算机芯片和商业制造。 总部位于加利福尼亚州的生物技术公司 Illumina 的发言人表示，塞森“很荣幸成为代表团的一员”，该公司希望这次旅行将成为“加强关系和塑造精准医疗未来的机会”。 其他公司的代表没有立即回应置评请求。 特朗普对中国的访问标志着两国之间脆弱的贸易休战的一次关键考验，此前两国在针锋相对的贸易战中征收了有时高达100%的关税。 特朗普在韩国与习近平最后一次会面后，关税于 2025 年 10 月暂停。 即将举行的会议的一大焦点将是美国和以色列在伊朗的战争，这已经迫使特朗普和习近平的会面推迟。 预计特朗普将推动依赖伊朗获取廉价石油的中国帮助促成德黑兰和华盛顿之间达成协议以结束战争。 中国也希望结束冲突。它限制了该国的石油供应，打击了进口中国商品的世界其他国家的购买力。 但迄今为止，中国丰富的石油储量和多样化的能源供应帮助其比许多邻国更好地抵御了战争的影响。

reflection.en: High-level diplomatic visits, especially those involving significant economic figures, underscore the complexity of international relations. The proverb reminds us that in the multitude of counselors there is safety, suggesting that important national decisions benefit from diverse perspectives and wise advice. reflection.zh: 高级别的外交访问，特别是涉及重要经济人物的访问，凸显了国际关系的复杂性。这句箴言提醒我们，谋士众多，人便安居，这表明重要的国家决策受益于多样的视角和明智的建议。当领导人应对错综复杂的全球挑战时，寻求广泛的忠告可以为所有人带来更稳定和有益的成果。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Trump heads to China to spread the gospel of American tech while emulating Xi Jinping on AI
title.zh: 特朗普前往中国传播美国科技福音，同时效仿习近平发展人工智能

summary.en: US President Donald Trump is scheduled to visit China, accompanied by tech CEOs including Tim Cook and Elon Musk. The trip aims to discuss technology, particularly artificial intelligence, with Chinese President Xi Jinping.
summary.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将携包括蒂姆·库克和埃隆·马斯克在内的科技公司首席执行官访问中国。此行旨在与中国国家主席习近平讨论技术，特别是人工智能。

body.en: Tim Cook and Elon Musk, among other tech CEOS, will accompany the US president on a trip to China Donald Trump is heading to China this week. If his guest list is any clue, he wants to discuss technology with Xi Jinping , though perhaps after the war in Iran. On Monday, news broke that outgoing Apple CEO, Tim Cook, as well as SpaceX and Tesla CEO, Elon Musk, would join the US president. Other guests from the tech sphere include Meta’s recently appointed president, Dina Powell McCormick; Sanjay Mehrotra, CEO of computer memory maker Micron; Chuck Robbins, CEO of longtime telecom giant Cisco; and Cristiano Amon, CEO of semiconductor maker Qualcomm, according to a White House official. Continue reading...
body.zh: 蒂姆·库克和埃隆·马斯克等科技公司首席执行官将陪同美国总统访问中国唐纳德·特朗普本周将前往中国。如果他的嘉宾名单有任何线索的话，那就是他想与习近平讨论技术，尽管可能是在伊朗战争之后。周一，有消息称，即将离任的苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克以及 SpaceX 和特斯拉首席执行官埃隆·马斯克将加入美国总统行列。来自科技领域的其他嘉宾包括 Meta 最近任命的总裁 Dina Powell McCormick； Sanjay Mehrotra，计算机内存制造商美光科技首席执行官；查克·罗宾斯 (Chuck Robbins)，老牌电信巨头思科的首席执行官；据白宫官员称，还有半导体制造商高通首席执行官克里斯蒂亚诺·阿蒙(Cristiano Amon)。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The pursuit of advanced technology like AI by global powers reflects humanity's remarkable capacity for innovation and collective endeavor. Yet, as nations strive for technological supremacy, this story reminds us of the immense potential, and perhaps the inherent limits, of human ambition when focused solely on what we can achieve.
reflection.zh: 全球大国对人工智能等先进技术的追求，反映了人类卓越的创新能力和集体努力。然而，当各国竞相争夺技术霸权时，这个故事提醒我们，如果人类的雄心壮志只专注于我们能做什么，其潜力是巨大的，但也许也存在固有的局限。

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: With the tournament a month away, there are still no agreements done with the two Asian giants to ensure fans there can watch all 104 games When Fifa expanded the World Cup from 32 to 48 teams, it was in the hope that countries such as India and China, with their 2.7 billion residents, would qualify rather than countries such as Cape Verde and Curaçao, whose combined population of about 700,000 barely equals a district of a megacity such as Mumbai or Shanghai. What the governing body did not account for was that, with the 2026 tournament a month away, there would be no broadcasting deals done with the two Asian giants to ensure fans there can watch the 104 games. title.en: Donald Trump is set to land in China for historic talks — and he's bringing an old friend
title.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普即将登陆中国进行历史性会谈——他带来了一位老朋友

summary.en: The US president is due in Beijing on Thursday for a two-day summit with Xi Jinping.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump is set to visit Beijing on Thursday for a historic meeting between the world leaders, the first on Chinese soil in nearly a decade.

The 14 to 15 May meeting had originally been scheduled for March. However, US-Israeli strikes on Iran, which sparked the war in the Middle East , caused a delay in proceedings.

On the agenda is a normalisation of trade relations following a tariff war Trump announced last year , which saw import taxes rise to as high as 145 per cent. The fate of Taiwan is also likely to be discussed, as is the possible regulation of artificial intelligence.

China claims Taiwan as its own territory, which should be taken by force if necessary. Taiwan says it is an independent country and will defend its freedoms and democracy

The war in the Middle East is, however, likely to dominate. China is reportedly very concerned about the prospect of a global recession as the conflict continues to drag on, impacting energy supplies and trade.

The US is likely to request assistance from China — as the major buyer of Iranian oil — in pressuring the Middle Eastern nation to open the blockaded Strait of Hormuz .

Analysts have suggested that the meeting is unlikely to result in any major breakthroughs, although a pause in tariff escalations could be extended beyond the current October deadline.

Trump "kind of needs China more than China needs him," Alejandro Reyes, a professor specialising in Chinese foreign policy at the University of Hong Kong told the Reuters news agency.

"He needs a kind of foreign policy victory: a victory that shows that he is looking to ensure stability in the world and that he's not just disrupting global politics."

A White House official has confirmed to US broadcaster Bloomberg that Tesla boss Elon Musk and outgoing Apple CEO Tim Cook have been invited to accompany Trump during his visit to Beijing.

The invitation has been extended to other leaders in technology and finance, with representatives from asset manager BlackRock, investment bank Goldman Sachs, semi conductor coporation Qualcomm, Boeing, Meta Platforms, Mastercard, and Visa among the more than a dozen business officials requested.

The executives from some of the US' most powerful business groups could be there to encourage trade normalisation and potentially make deals with Chinese producers.

Exports of rare earth minerals to the US were temporarily halted during the trade war last year, materials that are essential for the output of US technology firms.

Musk, the outspoken billionaire who once headed Trump's so-called Department of Government Efficiency , has yet to confirm whether or not he will be attending.

Still, the invitation suggests another shift in the thawing relationship between Trump and...

title.en: China should stop hoarding food and fertiliser, says former World Bank chief

body.en:
A former World Bank president has told the BBC that China should stop hoarding food and fertiliser to ease a global supply crisis caused by the Iran war.

David Malpass, who also served as Treasury Under Secretary for International Affairs under US President Donald Trump from 2017 to 2019, was speaking to the World Service's World Business Report on the eve of the Trump-Xi summit in Beijing.

"They have the biggest world stockpile of food stuffs and of fertiliser," he said. "They can stop building their stockpiles."

His comments come as nations around the world scramble to secure fertiliser supplies ahead of spring planting, with the closure of the Strait of Hormuz severely disrupting shipments.

China has halted exports of several types of fertiliser since March, citing the need to protect domestic supplies.

This came on top of restrictions that have been steadily been put in place since 2021.

Last year, China accounted for around 25% of global output of fertiliser, with exports totalling more than $13bn (£9.6bn).

Malpass, who ran the World Bank from 2019 to 2023, also said that Beijing's claim to be a developing nation is no longer credible.

"They present themselves as a developing country when they're the second biggest economy in the world and in many ways rich," he said.

"And yet they still have the pretence of being a developing country in the WTO and in the World Bank, and they could suspend that," Malpass added.

"China is committed to maintaining the stability of global food and fertilizer markets," Liu Pengyu, spokesperson for the Chinese embassy in Washington DC told the BBC in an emailed statement.

"The root causes behind the current disruptions in global food and fertilizer supply chains are crystal clear; this blame cannot be shifted onto China," he added.

In response to Malpass' comment on China's status as a developing country, Liu said "China is universally recognized as the largest developing country - a designation grounded in ample factual evidence."

"Upholding its status as a developing country is a legitimate right of China," he added.

On the Iran ceasefire, which Trump on Monday described as being on "massive life support", Malpass said the world should unite behind the United States and demand a resolution.

"You can't have a rogue state with plutonium, and you can't block the Strait of Hormuz," he said.

Malpass, was hopeful that China would help find a resolution to the deadlock in the Strait of Hormuz, saying that the free movement of ships was in its economic interest: "China benefits from open waterways worldwide."
